Use case: stylized-concept. Production portrait4:5travel puzzle PAINTED CLEAN BACKGROUND. Scene: A pair of scooters outside a tiny repair shop. View: close cozy three-quarter view. No flat vector art, no photographic collage, no generic geometric filler. Dominant main colour: golden yellow (#DFC260), clearly occupying the largest coherent surfaces, with balanced contrasting details. Composition is generic travel subject matter; NO recognizable destination landmarks, city names, signs, letters or logos. No UI or border. This is a finished clean plate for five separately painted motion details. Paint complete underlying surfaces at all five declared positions; do not draw the five named foreground details, leave no transparent hole or blank placeholder. Portrait master1280x1600. Part placements for later composition: a small pale cloud behind the vehicle at normalised rect [0.13, 0.1, 0.25, 0.14]; a little tied pennant or luggage ribbon at normalised rect [0.64, 0.3, 0.12, 0.16]; a roadside or shore leaf cluster at normalised rect [0.08, 0.67, 0.18, 0.22]; a scene-specific grass or flower cluster at normalised rect [0.72, 0.74, 0.2, 0.16]; a soft cloud wisp or water highlight appropriate to the setting at normalised rect [0.45, 0.17, 0.22, 0.11]. The painting must remain attractive and complete underneath those parts.
MANDATORY FULLY OPAQUE RGB painting, alpha255 at every pixel, no transparency. Actual scene refinement: A tiny unbranded scooter repair shop, golden-yellow plaster facade, mustard-painted door and warm yellow paving dominate. Exactly two small classic scooters, one creamy yellow and one muted teal accent, parked fully in view with coherent wheels, handlebars, seats and kickstands. No brand, numberplate letters, signs, text, tools floating, people or recognisable location. A leafy pot by the door and a small upper sky strip. Warm storybook texture, not photo collage. No ribbons or separate loose flowers yet. Portrait4:5, no UI or border.
